LITERACY ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use Story Telling to shame classmates.
   C. Copy a rumour about Story Telling without checking.
   D. Treat Story Telling as empty slogans with no facts.
